newsitem.title: JORDAN: King Hussein to visit Egypt for coordination talks.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein to visit Egypt for coordination talks.

text.p: King Hussein will travel to the Egyptian city of Aswan on Wednesday to hold talks with Egyptian leader Hosni Mubarak on peace talks with Israel, a palace official said on Tuesday.
The one-day talks are part of regular coordination between the two leaders to review the latest developments in Middle East peace moves, the official said.
Jordan is worried that lack of progress in moving ahead in implementing Israeli-Palestinian peace accords could endanger regional stability.
It has recently stepped up its criticism of Israel, accusing it of endangering the kingdom's security by re-activating plans for expanding Jewish settlements in the West Bank.
